notes: N068_01 — The upper paragraph begins with the continuation word précédemment. It describes the author's two written possibilities, both introduced by soit: courbes de type (0,nu_2) and courbes relatives de type (0,nu_2). Its references to earlier material are not expanded beyond the text on this leaf.

N068_02 — The second paragraph begins On procède de proche en proche and uses the abbreviation finalt. The source parenthesis begins car tt corps ext. de type fini de Q and continues with est ext finie d'une ext. transcendante pure. These are the author's words; no mathematical check was performed for this page.

N068_03 — The author's own qualification “Sauf erreur” is retained. The following sentence speaks of a syst. fondamental de voisinages and ends with X lisse sur un K. The d'une/d'un sequence is left locally doubtful, and no final full stop is supplied.

N068_04 — The source has three actual cancelled passages: de type, the first étale in the adjacent pair, and the tentative E before E_Q. The first ext. and ça remain live after tracing the visible letter strokes. There are no separately marked interlinear insertions, marginal prose, displays, diagrams or drawings on this leaf.
N068_05 — Foliation 67 is present at the lower left in a separate thin numeral hand. No separate authorial page number is visible at the head of the page.
